correctness.rationale: For G=K_p∨independent_q in zero-sum H dimension d=p+q−1, project onto clique contrasts, independent contrasts and one between-part direction. Clique roots have support square 2a; cross roots support square (p−1)a/p+(q−1)b/q+Nc/(pq), N=p+q. Piecewise a,b,c are positive and cross support one. Construct weighted Laplacian from all cross edges weight w and clique edges v: when q≥p+1 use (w,v)=(1/(pq),0); else (2/[d(p+1)],2(p+1−q)/[dp(p+1)]). Their weights sum 1 and eigenvalues invert the proposed S via S=(dL)^{-1}. Any translated inscribed ellipsoid has tr(LT)≤1; AMGM det(L)det(T)≤d^{-d}, equality gives T=S and cross-root spanning forces center zero. Therefore unique global John ellipsoid, not just symmetric optimum. Clique support 2a≤1 hits equality exactly q≤p+1, but becomes strict q≥p+2. Bipartite ellipsoid comparison yields invisibility iff q≥p+1. Independent exact rational checks p,q=(3,2),(3,4),(3,5),(4,3),(4,5),(5,8) including boundary and Laplacian inverses passed.
